guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: emailservice_mem is the only resource series with a meaningful shift (+36.9%, z=+7.38), and emailservice_latency-50 also moved sharply (z=-13.94), though it fell, which is odd for a fault. Logs have no error or warning lines and the traces show errors in checkoutservice, frontend and paymentservice but never emailservice, so the evidence is weak.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect emailservice for a memory leak or growth (heap profile, recent deploy); if confirmed, restart or roll back the pod and set a memory limit. Also check paymentservice, since it carries error spans in the worst trace.
